# Test what happens when pressing UP at different positions
# Current markers are at pos 0 (col 15)

def get_pink_hashes():
    nodes = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
    pink = []
    for n in nodes:
        if n['color'] == 'B':
            min_row = min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])
            min_col = min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
            parent_color = None
            for other in nodes:
                if n['id'] in other.get('children', []):
                    parent_color = other['color']
                    break
            if parent_color == 'P' and min_row >= 50:
                pink.append((min_col, n['hash'][:8]))
    pink.sort()
    return [h for _, h in pink]

def get_sky_hashes():
    nodes = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
    sky = []
    for n in nodes:
        if n['color'] == 'B':
            min_row = min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])
            min_col = min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
            parent_color = None
            for other in nodes:
                if n['id'] in other.get('children', []):
                    parent_color = other['color']
                    break
            if parent_color == 'S' and min_row >= 40:
                sky.append((min_col, n['hash'][:8]))
    sky.sort()
    return [h for _, h in sky]

print(f"Current pink: {get_pink_hashes()}")
print(f"Current sky: {get_sky_hashes()}")

# Press UP at pos 0
action(['UP'])
print(f"After UP at pos 0: pink={get_pink_hashes()}, sky={get_sky_hashes()}")

# Press UP again at pos 0
action(['UP'])
print(f"After 2nd UP at pos 0: pink={get_pink_hashes()}, sky={get_sky_hashes()}")

# Press UP again at pos 0
action(['UP'])
print(f"After 3rd UP at pos 0: pink={get_pink_hashes()}, sky={get_sky_hashes()}")

# Press UP again at pos 0
action(['UP'])
print(f"After 4th UP at pos 0: pink={get_pink_hashes()}, sky={get_sky_hashes()}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
